images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: finished raster illustration for an Italian university study website, inside an accordion about randomized algorithms. Generous spacing, simple uncluttered composition, no people, no robot, no circuit board, no glowing sci-fi decoration. Text: none. No words, labels, numerals, formulas, logo or watermark.

Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: finished raster illustration for an Italian university study website, inside an accordion about quantum interference. Primary request: two visual wave analogies comparing reinforcement and cancellation of amplitudes. Landscape 3:2, dark slate #292d36 background, mint green and soft periwinkle, finely textured editorial cut-paper style and restrained lighting, crisp at mobile size, matching a sober educational illustration series. Exactly two widely spaced horizontal rows. Upper row: two equal smooth waves, drawn separately in small inputs with identical phase, flow via delicate connectors into a larger output wave of the same phase and visibly twice their amplitude. Lower row: two equal smooth waves with opposite phase, one mint and one periwinkle, flow via delicate connectors into a perfectly flat horizontal output line showing cancellation. Each input wave spans the same width and has the same wavelength and absolute amplitude. Keep wave baselines visible and align zero levels. This is a conceptual analogy for adding amplitudes, not an oscilloscope photo or a probability distribution. Large clean shapes with abundant breathing room. Text: none. No words, numbers, formulas, labels, icons, spheres, people, quantum computers, decorative objects, logo or watermark.
